Iyo igihugu kigize Umuryango kitubahirije
izindi nshingano zikomoka kuri aya Masezerano
nk’ikigize Umuryango gishobora guhagarikwa
n’icyemezo cy’Inama y’abaminisitiri cyafashwe
na bibiri bya gatatu by’abanyamuryango
bitabiriye kandi batora. Ubu bwiganze ni
ngombwa na none kugira ngo hafatwe icyemezo
cyo gukuraho icyemezo cyo guhagarika kuba
ikigize Umuryango. Igihugu kigize Umuryango
gihagaritswe kuba ikigize Umuryango
ntigisonerwa inshingano zacyo ku byerekeye
imari mu gihe cyo guhagarikwa.
INGINGO YA XV: ISOBANURWA NO
GUKEMURA AMAKIMBIRANE
1. Amakimbirane ayo ari yo yose yerekeye
isobanurwa cyangwa ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ingingo iyo ari yo yose y’aya Masezerano
kandi adashobora gukemurwa n’impande bireba
ashyikirizwa Inama y’abaminisitiri.
2. Iyo Inama y’abaminisitiri idashobora gufata
umwanzuro ku kibazo kiri mu makimbirane,
cyangwa iyo umwanzuro wayo utakiriwe
n’impande bireba, buri ruhande muri zo
rushobora gusaba ko ikibazo gishyikirizwa
ubukemurampaka bw’Urukiko nkemurampaka
rugizwe n’abanyamuryango batatu bashyizweho
mu buryo bukurikira:
(a) buri ruhande rushyiraho umukemurampaka
umwe;
(b) umukemurampaka wa gatatu uba umuyobozi
w’urukiko atorwa mu bw’ubwumvikane
bw’abakemurampaka bashyizweho n’impande.
3. Iyo ishyirwaho ry'umwe mu bagize inteko
y'abakemurampaka ridakozwe mu gihe cy'amezi
atatu uhereye igihe ubukemurampaka
bwasabiwe, rumwe mu mpande zifitanye
amakimbirane rushobora gusaba umuyobozi
w'Inama y’abaminisitiri gushyiraho
abakemurampaka bakenewe, usibye, igihe, iyo
Umuryango ubwawo ugize uruhande ruri mu
makimbirane, ishyirwaho rikorwa
n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’ubuyobozi
bw’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bwa Afurika.
4. Icyemezo cy'urukiko nkemurampaka kiba
itegeko ku mpande zifitanye amakimbirane.
5. Ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya 2, icya 3 n'icya 4
by'iyi ngingo ntibibangamira guhitamo ubundi
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo gukemura
amakimbirane impande zishobora kumvikanaho.
INGINGO YA XVI: ISESWA
1. Aya Masezerano ashyiriweho igihe gihoraho.
Ashobora guseswa n’icyemezo cyumvikanweho
na bose cy’inama y’abahagarariye ibihugu
byabo bigize uyu Muryango bafite ububaha.
Nyuma yo kujya inama n’Inama y'Ubutegetsi
ndetse n'ibihugu n'imiryango mfatanyabikorwa,
iseswa ry’aya Masezerano rivuga iseswa
ry’Umuryango.
2. Haseguriwe ibitegnywa mu gika cya 5
haruguru, aya Masezerano afatwa
nk’ayasheshwe iyo umubare w’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango ugiye munsi ya bitanu.
3. Iseswa ritangira gukurikizwa nyuma
y’umwaka umwe uhereye igihe icyemezo
cy’inama y’abahawe ububasha cyafashwe
hashingiwe ku gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo
cyangwa guhera ku itariki imenyesha ryo
kwikuramo ryagejeje umubare w’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango ku mubare uri munsi y’uvugwa mu
gika cya 2 cy’iyi ngingo ryakiriweho. Inama
y’abaminisitiri ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo
kongera igihe ntarengwa cy’umwaka umwe
uvugwa haruguru iyo iryo yongera riri ngombwa
mu iseswa ry’Umuryango mu buryo bukwiye.
4. Umuyobozi Mukuru ahita amenyesha ibihugu
byose bigize Umuryango, ibihugu n’imiryango
by’ubufatanye, Inama y’Ubutegetsi kimwe
n’Ushinzwe kubika Amasezerano, icyemezo
cy’inama y’abaminisitiri cyangwa imenyesha
ryo kwivana mu Masezerano bitewe n’impamvu
yatumye haba iseswa ry’aya Masezerano.
5. Inama y’abaminisitiri ifata ingamba zose za
ngombwa kugira ngo Umuryango wishyure
imyenda ndetse no kugabana umutungo wawo
mu bihugu bigize Umuryango, byumvikane
ariko ko inyubako, ibikoresho, by’Umuryango
bizakomeza gukoreshwa mu buryo bushoboka
kugira ngo hagerwe ku mpamvu byashyiriweho
mbere. Ibikoresho, n’inyubako byahawe
Umuryango n’ibihugu n’inzego z’ubufatanye
biraseswa bigiwemo inama na Leta n’imiryango
birebwa.
6. Iyo habaye iseswa rivugwa mu gika cya 2
cyavuzwe haruguru, inyandiko zo kwemera
cyangwa ubusabe bwo kuba ikigize Umuryango
bwakiriwe mu gihe giteganyijwe mu gika cya 3
cyavuzwe haruguru, hatumizwa inama
y’abahagarariye ibihugu bafite ububasha kugira
ngo hagenwe niba Amasezerano agomba
gukomeza gukurikizwa.
INGINGO YA XVII: GUTANGIRA
GUKURIKIZWA GUTANGA INYANDIKO
NO KWANDIKWA
1. Amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa iyo
ibihugu birindwi mu bihugu bigize akarere
byaryemeye hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya
XII.1 y'aya Masezerano.
2. Aya Masezerano agitangira gukurikizwa,
yandikwa n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru
w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 102 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ndetse n’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru w’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bwa
Afurika.
3 Inyandiko y’umwimerere y’aya Masezerano
ari mu ndimi z’Icyongereza n’Igifaransa
zinganya agaciro, ishyikirizwa Ushinzwe kubika
Amasezerano ushyikiriza inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere Guverinoma z’ibihugu byose
bigize Umuryango. Ubunyamabanga
bumenyesha Umunyamabanga Mukuru
w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Ubumwe bwa Afurika ukwemera uko ari ko
kose, amavugururwa yose no kwivana mu
Masezerano kwose.
BAMAZE KWEMERA IBIKUBIYE MURI
AYA MASEZERANO, abahagarariye ibihugu
byabo bakurikira bayashyizeho umukono.
(Amazina y'abahagarariye)
Bikorewe i Dakar, ku munsi wa kane Nzeri
1970 mu nyandiko imwe iri mu ndimi
z’Icyongereza n'Igifaransa, buri nyandiko
inganya agaciro n’indi.
